1SNQ: Akal Purakh is One, and is found through the grace of the True Guru.
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
There is but One God By the True Guru's grace, He is obtained.
TJZX: Raag Nat-Narayan: a Bani of eight-stanza hymns by Guru Ram Das ji.
XY22: Ram = O Ram! Man = in the mind. Tan = in the body. Adhare = support.
O Ram! In my mind and in my body Your Name alone is the support.
O Lord, Your Name is the support of my mind and body.
My Master, Your Name is the support of my soul and body Even for an instant and a moment.
O brother! In my mind and body the Name alone is the support.
H1NV: Sakau = I can. Reh na sakau = I cannot live. Seva = devotion. Gurmat = taking the Guru's teaching. Samhare = I have kept. ||1|| Rahau ||
I cannot live even an instant or a moment without doing Your service and devotion. Taking the Guru's shelter, I keep Your Name enshrined in my heart. ||1|| Rahau ||
I cannot survive for a moment, even for an instant, without serving You. Following the Guru's Teachings, I dwell upon the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
I can life not without the Lord's service. Through the Guru instruction, utter I, His Name. Pause.
I cannot live even an instant or a moment without the service of the Lord. Through the Guru's teaching I have kept hold of the Name alone. ||1|| Rahau ||
6PPW: Mai = to me. Piare = feels dear.
You too, always meditate on Parmatma. To me, Hari's Name alone feels dear.
Within my mind, I meditate on the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har, Har. The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is so dear to me.
God, God, God, God, God, heartily remember I, and dear to me is the Lord-God's Name.
With every breath I meditate in my mind on the Name Har Har, which makes one green at every moment. The Names Har Har are dear to me.
QDST: Daial = merciful. Kai sabad = through the Word of. Savare = sets right. ||1||
The poor ones on whom the Master Prabhu is merciful — He makes their life beautiful through the Guru's Word. ||1||
When God, my Lord and Master, became merciful to me the meek one, I was exalted by the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||
When the Lord-Master became merciful to me, the meek one, I got embellished with the Guru's word.
When the able Thakur became merciful to me, the humble one, then the Guru's teaching set my heart right. ||1||
R2NP: Madh soodan = O Madhusudan {slayer of the demon Madhu}, O Parmatma! Jag jeevan = O support of the world! Madho = {ma-dhav, husband of Maya} O Master of Maya! Agam = O unreachable! Apare = O limitless!
O Madhusudan! O Life of the world! O Madho! O my Master! O unreachable! O limitless!
Almighty Lord, Slayer of demons, Life of the World, my Lord and Master, inaccessible and infinite:
My Master is the Lover of Nectar, the Life of the world, the Lord of wealth, Inaccessible and Infinite.
He is the destroyer of the demon Madhu, the one who gives life to the world, the husband of Lakshmi, my Thakur, unreachable and limitless.
7P4N: Binau = {vinaya} request. Karau = I make. Aagai = before. Sadhu = the Guru. Pakhare = may I wash. ||2||
(If You show grace, then, to gain Your Name,) may I keep making requests to the Guru always, and may I keep washing the Guru's feet. ||2||
I offer this one prayer to the Guru, to bless me, that I may wash the feet of the Holy. ||2||
I pray and supplicate the Guru to bless me with the gift of washing the saints' feet.
Humbly I make one request before the Guru: O Guru! May I wash the feet of the saints. ||2||
564Y: Sahas = thousands. Netr = eyes. Nirare = apart, untouched.
(All-pervading) Prabhu has thousands of eyes; (yet) that all-pervading Prabhu stays forever untouched.
The thousands of eyes are the eyes of God; the One God, the Primal Being, remains unattached.
The thousands of eyes of the beings, are the eyes of the Lord, yet the Omnipotent Lord remains but all-aloof.
The hundreds of eyes that beings have are eyes fixed on Prabhu. In His cosmic form that able One is one Being. So He is said to be (nirare) apart — meaning without a second, or unattached.
7JHH: Moorat = form, body. Gurmat = (giving) the Guru's teaching. Tare = carries across. ||3||
That Master Prabhu has thousands of bodies, yet He is one, like no one but Himself. He Himself carries beings across the world-ocean through the Guru's teaching. ||3||
The One God, our Lord and Master, has thousands of forms; God alone, through the Guru's Teachings, saves us. ||3||
The unique Lord Master has thousands of forms, It is the Lord alone who saves the mortals through the Guru's instruction.
In the thousands of forms, one able Thakur pervades. That one Prabhu carries across through the Guru's teaching. ||3||
Z1J6: Damodar = {dama-udara, he around whose waist is a cord, Krishna} Parmatma. Ur = in the heart.
The person who has found Parmatma's Name through the Guru's teaching keeps that Name always enshrined in their heart.
Following the Guru's Teachings, I have been blessed with the Naam, the Name of the Lord. I have enshrined within my heart the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
By Guru's instruction, I am blessed with the Lord's Name and it is the Lord-God's Name, that I keep clasped to my heart.
Those who follow the Guru's teaching have found the Name of Damodar; they have enshrined the Name Har Har alone in their heart.
2XPK: Ati = very. Gatak = gulping, (eating) with great relish. Samhare = keeps. ||4||

Parmatma's praise feels very sweet to them; they keep it in their heart at every moment (but tell no one), as a mute person drinks (some sherbet) with great relish (and cannot describe the taste). ||4||
The sermon of the Lord, Har, Har, is so very sweet; like the mute, I taste its sweetness, but I cannot describe it at all. ||4||
Exceedingly sweet is the Lord Master's gospel. Like a dumb man, I can only quaff it with relish, but can describe not.

The story of Har Har has become supremely sweet. Just as a mute person, finding joy, (gatak) jumps about — meaning is happy — but cannot tell that joy, so the taste of Hari's story cannot be told. (Samare) Remembering it, the devotees are in bliss and cannot tell it. ||4||
DGRT: Rasna = tongue. Saad = tastes {plural}. Bhai = in love. Doojai bhai = (caught) in love of Maya. Pheeke = tasteless.
The person whose tongue keeps tasting (other things') tastes because of attachment to Maya stays caught in greed and other utterly tasteless vices.
The tongue savors the bland, insipid taste of the love of duality, greed and corruption.
The tongue enjoys the extremely insipid relish of another's love avarice and sin.

The self-willed, joined to vices such as greed, enjoy the tastes of duality — the objects of Maya — through the tongue and all the other senses. Those are tasteless and bitter — meaning they are passing, and mixed with suffering.
ZL2G: Chakhah = taste {plural}. An ras = countless other tastes. ||5||
Those who stay facing the Guru and enjoy the bliss of Parmatma's Name forget the taste of all other pleasures. ||5||
The Gurmukh tastes the flavor of the Lord's Name, and all other tastes and flavors are forgotten. ||5||
The Guru-ward tastes the deliciousness of the Lord's Name and forgets all other savours and relishes.
The Gurmukhs who taste the flavour of Ram's Names forget the taste of all other pleasures. ||5||
BNEL: Those who have found the wealth of Parmatma's Name through the Guru's teaching always remove their sins by hearing and speaking the Name.
Following the Guru's Teachings, I have obtained the wealth of the Lord's Name; hearing it, and chanting it, sins are eradicated.
By Guru's instruction, I have obtained the wealth of the Lord's Name, hearing and uttering which my sins are eradicated.
Those who have found the wealth of Ram's Name through the Guru's teaching — that Name takes away the sins of those who hear it and speak it.
N486: Such people are dear to the Master Prabhu; neither Dharamraj nor (any of his) messengers of death comes near them. ||6||
The Messenger of Death and the Righteous Judge of Dharma do not even approach the beloved servant of my Lord and Master. ||6||
The courier of the Righteous Judge draws not near the beloved slave of my Master.
Those who are my Thakur's beloved servants — Dharam Rai's messenger does not come near them. ||6||
8M0F: However many breaths of life there are, (in them) I keep remembering only Parmatma's Name, on the support of the Guru's teaching.
With as many breaths as I have, I chant the Naam, under Guru's Instructions.
As many breaths, that I breathe; with so many breaths, utter I the Lord's Name under the Guru's instruction.
(Saas) breath upon breath, again and again, through the Guru's teaching I keep hold of the Name alone in them.
5UCY: Any breath that goes without Prabhu's Name goes in vain; it goes to waste. ||7||
Each and every breath which escapes me without the Naam - that breath is useless and corrupt. ||7||
Every breath, which escapes without the Name; that breath is useless and sinful.
The breath that goes without the Name is a breath in vain; and the breath that goes in vices is wasted too. ||7||
SST1: O Nanak! O Prabhu! I, the humble one, have come to Your shelter; show me mercy, show me mercy. Unite me with Your beloved devotees.
Please grant Your Grace; I am meek; I seek Your Sanctuary, God. Unite me with Your beloved, humble servants.
O Lord-God, I the meek one, have sought Yours refuge, Take You pity, on me and unite me with Your beloved slaves.
O treasure of mercy! Show mercy. Becoming humble, O Prabhu, we have come to Your shelter. Unite me with the (har jan) saints who are dear to You.
